name: The Living Draft
postCreateCommand: npm ci && npm run seed -- --no-art && npm run build

LIVING_DRAFT_AI_URL.description: Optional. An OpenAI-compatible endpoint for a faster hosted model, e.g. https://api.groq.com/openai/v1. Leave empty to run the model inside the Codespace.

LIVING_DRAFT_AI_KEY.description: Optional. The API key for that endpoint.

LIVING_DRAFT_AI_MODEL.description: Optional. The model name at that endpoint.

LIVING_DRAFT_SMTP.description: Optional. smtp://user:password@host:587 so sign-up codes and reset links are emailed.
